verdict.rationale: The Skills repository is publicly hosted on GitHub with fully readable SKILL.md files, templates, and example skills (anthropic-skills-gh-1/3/5, anthropic-skills-docs-13), and Anthropic states it has 'published Agent Skills as an open standard for cross-platform portability' (anthropic-skills-docs-67), plus a public specification site (agentskills.io). This shows the source/spec is openly readable and portable, but the evidence never names or cites an explicit open-source license (e.g., MIT/Apache) governing the repo or SKILL.md content. missing for 10: explicit license file/name evidence, independent confirmation the repo/spec is licensed for reuse rather than just publicly viewable.
